description: Open a private upload scope for the buyer’s photo, artwork, logo or QR card. Omit both inputs for a new scope, or pass an unpaid order and its token to reopen that draft’s scope. Returns scope_id, a private token, upload_url and expiry. Assistants cannot upload conversation attachments; send the buyer the link, then use read_private_content when they finish. Catalog cards need no upload scope.

order_access_token.description: Matching private token for the existing unpaid order, returned by prepare_order, revise_order or its open_private_content scope. Required with order_id; omit both for a new scope. Never invent a token.

order_id.description: Existing unpaid order.id from prepare_order, revise_order or read_order. Supply its matching order_access_token to reopen that draft’s upload scope; omit both fields for a new scope.

name: open_private_content
title: Open private uploads
